anchors.1: Consequential teaching/example error or invented source/assessment claim.
anchors.2: Substantial deficiencies between anchors 1 and 3; cannot be trusted without major revision.
anchors.3: Generally correct but an important explanation/check is incomplete or weakly supported.
anchors.4: Strong, usable result with no material defect; only limited non-consequential improvement remains.
anchors.5: Correct, scoped, source-aware explanations and checked examples; no consequential uncertainty is concealed.

anchors.1: Ignores diagnostic errors or treats confidence, videos or completion as mastery.
anchors.2: Substantial deficiencies between anchors 1 and 3; cannot be trusted without major revision.
anchors.3: Mentions the student but priorities/methods change little in response to actual evidence.
anchors.4: Strong, usable result with no material defect; only limited non-consequential improvement remains.
anchors.5: Distinctive priorities and support follow the actual errors, strengths, resources, preferences and demonstrated evidence.

dimensions.title: Educational depth, independent transfer and stopping

anchors.1: Generic reread/practice instructions, unusable materials or invalid success criteria.
anchors.2: Substantial deficiencies between anchors 1 and 3; cannot be trusted without major revision.
anchors.3: Useful methods but examples, feedback, transfer or stopping criteria need material improvement.
anchors.4: Strong, usable result with no material defect; only limited non-consequential improvement remains.
anchors.5: Actionable explanation, complete givens, useful feedback and genuinely independent application; stop/support rules serve the outcome.

anchors.1: Silently drops accepted scope or prescribes unjustified mandatory work.
anchors.2: Substantial deficiencies between anchors 1 and 3; cannot be trusted without major revision.
anchors.3: Scope is mostly covered but priorities, prerequisite logic or practice necessity are weak.
anchors.4: Strong, usable result with no material defect; only limited non-consequential improvement remains.
anchors.5: Complete justified coverage/deferral, coherent prerequisites and necessary workload; secure areas avoid filler.

anchors.1: Impossible workload, invented availability, double-booking, deadline violation or changed protected work.
anchors.2: Substantial deficiencies between anchors 1 and 3; cannot be trusted without major revision.
anchors.3: Technically feasible but fragile pacing, disproportionate effort or unclear study logistics.
anchors.4: Strong, usable result with no material defect; only limited non-consequential improvement remains.
anchors.5: Executable within genuine capacity, commitments and deadlines, with defensible effort ranges, recovery and realistic student actions.

anchors.1: Loses consequential conditions/examples/criteria, invents compulsory education or books optional work as required.
anchors.2: Substantial deficiencies between anchors 1 and 3; cannot be trusted without major revision.
anchors.3: Mechanically mapped but a material detail or distinction is weakened.
anchors.4: Strong, usable result with no material defect; only limited non-consequential improvement remains.
anchors.5: Every consequential educational element survives in execution or explicit guidance; dependencies, resources, uncertainty and stopping retain their meaning.

dimensions.title: Independent review accuracy and substantive improvement

anchors.1: Approves a serious defect, raises an unsupported blocker or claims a false objection was repaired.
anchors.2: Substantial deficiencies between anchors 1 and 3; cannot be trusted without major revision.
anchors.3: Finds some issues but misses a material one or only checks named changes.
anchors.4: Strong, usable result with no material defect; only limited non-consequential improvement remains.
anchors.5: Correctly grounded whole-result judgment; valid improvements are independently rechecked and false concerns are withdrawn. Unobserved refinement/sensitivity stays unobserved.

anchors.1: Guesses essential facts/permissions or conceals missing material.
anchors.2: Substantial deficiencies between anchors 1 and 3; cannot be trusted without major revision.
anchors.3: Discloses gaps but asks avoidable questions or gives weak decision support.
anchors.4: Strong, usable result with no material defect; only limited non-consequential improvement remains.
anchors.5: Asks only consequential missing facts, uses actual answers, distinguishes claims/evidence and preserves student decisions and uncertainty.

proposedIndividualThreshold.incompleteCoreObservation: No exceptional-quality pass; retain unobserved facets separately, without dropping them from the denominator.

mechanicalGates: Feasible deterministic actual allocation and unchanged protected/unselected work
Complete STOP responses and truthful role/root accounting
No uncertain dispatch, missing permissions or stale Calendar/source clearance
Actual reviewed publication before separate disposable Apply, with receipt replay

raterProtocol.qualificationRaterType: Independent subject-competent humans; disagreement adjudicated against evidence, not by the runtime reviewer
raterProtocol.initialPilotAssessment: Provisional source-based audit by this assistant/user is permitted but is not independent human qualification. This assistant also authored the cases.
blindTo: Runtime verdict and issue history until an initial independent defect list is locked

consistencyClaim: One pilot is formative. Release ambition remains independently authored, at least 100 stratified held-out cases, repeated samples, matched strong reference workflows, per-stratum results and uncertainty; separately funded.
